text:
Sam: morning trivia — which is worse: a tab in YAML or `1..0` in semver? :thinking_face:
Jo: tab in YAML because it silently haunts CI for days. semver screams loudly. :sweat_smile:
Marta: can we have both? Asking for a friend. :joy:
Sam: behold the artifact of chaos:
```yaml
service:
	name: ghost-runner
  replicas: 1
version: "1..0"
```
Jo: oh wow. tab + two-space combo plus dotted dot semver. commitment to chaos. :skull:
Lint-Bot: lint failure: indentation error at line 2; semver validation failed at `version`
Marta: I nominate this for the "Hall of Accidental Innovation" plaque. or at least a sticker. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Sam: poll: immediate fix (:one:), sticker and documentation (:two:), or call it performance art and do nothing (:three:)?
Jo: :one: we fix. also the person who pushed it owes the team donuts. :doughnut:
Marta: :two: but add a small plaque: "Here lies `1..0` — may it never semver again."
Sam: Lint-Bot just retriggered the fix branch. pipeline started.
Lint-Bot: pipeline #9999: branch fix/remove-tab-and-dot — linter passed, tests running
Jo: victory. pizza after deploy? or a sticker?
Marta: both. deploy party with stickers. and a mandatory YAML linter in pre-commit. :tada:
Sam: lesson learned: semver tells you what broke, YAML quietly judges you in the shadows. :sparkles:
